[LSTO.5.3] **Implementation constraint.** Because `cached()` is
always sync, the read path must never leave the engine: the engine
serves it from its own in-engine cache ([LSTO.4.7.1]), so no read
blocks the rule-firing loop. Durability is the integration's, via
the optional write-through shape ([LSTO.4.3.2]); a rule that needs a
remote store queried on demand uses `call storage.*` instead.
